items.reason: Verifier results write timestamped documents under the set’s verify directory.
Reports accumulate without sequential overwrites; fallback completes before the single report write.
The response contract retains the verdict first, and the remaining prose becomes the report body.
Verdict parsing is unchanged; malformed replies retain their raw text and empty replies retain an explanation.
Report writing applies to PASS, FIXABLE, and NEEDS-HUMAN.
Passing responses must explain the checks and evidence for each acceptance criterion.
Cached verdicts return before report-writing code.
Invalidation still deletes cached verdicts without deleting report files.
Previous Verify reports are not loaded into prompts; human-note forwarding remains unchanged.
Human acceptance writes a report without invoking an agent.
Human reports include the rationale and overridden verdict.
Human reports explicitly identify human authorship in their header and body.
Human reports use the same writer, directory, timestamp format, header machinery, and latest-report resolver.
The gate preamble displays the latest report’s path and commit facts without its prose.
The paging action opens the Verify report and returns to the gate menu.
The task-set detail view includes a Verify report pointer.
Verify artifacts rank above Refine artifacts.
Agent-facing views gain no Verify pointer; only Verifier response-contract goldens change.
Absent Verify reports produce no corresponding preamble, paging entry, detail section, or artifact.
Status and verified-at derivation remain independent of report existence and age.
Status rows retain truncated findings but gain no report pointer; only the parked summary and separate detail section gain one.
Both passes share rendering, filing, timestamp scanning, header parsing, and pointer machinery.
Refine retains its directory, filename format, headers, and existing rendering through the shared implementation.
Refine prompt golden files are unchanged.

scores.rationale: Clear shared implementation with substantial focused tests; status-row pointers are incomplete, and transaction-failure behavior lacks coverage.
